sentences.text: Florida charters see a lot of heat illness.
Heat exhaustion causes pale, cool, sweaty skin, weakness and nausea.
Get the person into shade, cool them, give fluids and let them rest.
Heat stroke is a true emergency, with hot skin, confusion or collapse.
Cool them aggressively with water and fanning, and call for help immediately.
Hypothermia can happen even in Florida after time in the water.
Remove wet clothing, insulate the person, and warm the core gently.
Don’t rub their arms and legs, and don’t give alcohol.
Prevent sunburn and dehydration with shade, sunscreen and plenty of water.
